purpose: Frontend discovery and fallback bridge for the unified atlas. Backend datasets remain modular; humans enter through a small number of stable gateways.

fallback_policy.live_source_failure: show repository-backed data and mark live enrichment unavailable
fallback_policy.json_failure: skip optional dataset and continue with canonical datasets
fallback_policy.country_failure: fall back from live country source to country index, country-atlas, country-nodes and local enrichment
fallback_policy.empty_description: show record identity plus available relationships and evidence rather than a blank page

integrity_requirements: Every visible Atlas entry has a route or explicit external-only state
Every relationship endpoint resolves or is explicitly marked unresolved
No single live-source request is allowed to blank the Atlas
Unknown data is represented as missing/unknown, never as zero
Backend-only datasets remain discoverable through the Atlas index
Canonical IDs remain stable while aliases may expand
Deep surfaces are linked from Explore rather than duplicated in the global header
design_rule: Navigation should reveal the structure of the knowledge without becoming the structure itself. The global header is intentionally small; Explore is the complete human-facing directory; Repository is the machine-backed record browser.
